title: sapota obovata
intro: Sapota obovata, commonly known as the yellow sapote, is a deciduous tree native to Central and South America, belonging to the family Sapotaceae. The fruit of the yellow sapote tree is rich in nutrients and has been found to offer several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties. The therapeutic actions of yellow sapote include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and provide relief from digestive issues. Bioactive constituents of the yellow sapote include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
